So where does GITHUB_TOKEN come in?

Maybe the gradle build uses `io.github.resilience4j` or similar. Actually, wait — maybe some dependency is pulled from a GitHub Packages maven repo (maven.pkg.github.com). Let me look for maven.pkg.github.com in the build files.
